assessment_objectives.objective: the time period within which data subject rights requests are to be acknowledged is defined.
the time period within which data subject rights requests are to be fulfilled is defined.
a process to receive and acknowledge data subject rights requests is implemented.
a process to fulfill data subject rights requests in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations is implemented.
one or more publicly accessible and easy to use channels are provided for data subjects to submit rights requests.
the identity of the data subject, or their authorized agent, is validated before a data subject rights request is fulfilled.
data subject rights requests are tracked from receipt through fulfillment or denial.
records of each data subject rights request, including the validation performed, the action taken and the date of response, are retained.
receipt of data subject rights requests is acknowledged to the data subject within the organization-defined time period.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: within ten (10) business days of receipt

assessment_objectives.objective: data subject rights requests are fulfilled, or denied with the reason for denial communicated to the data subject, within the organization-defined time period.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: within one (1) month of receipt, extendable only where permitted by applicable law

assessment_objectives.objective: the statutory, regulatory and/or contractual obligations applicable to data subject rights requests are identified.
